analysis:
Examined all supplied test source, duplicate patches and added-file metadata, plus the bounded AddonIPCServerTests.swift excerpt. No concrete security regression is established by these test additions; assertions are intended contracts, not proof of production enforcement. AddonCommandTests.swift:11-33 tests 30–600-second leases and fresh process targeting; :54-66 covers hold snapshot serialization. AddonHoldLoopTests.swift:100-159 tests admission closure, model shutdown and per-peer ownership; :191-306 exercises bounded draining, update/reconnect/stop precedence and restart persistence. :245-267 deliberately retains expired holds while the machine lock is held; :309-333 permits explicit operator force release. AddonHoldServeLoopTests.swift:17-18 injects authentication only in the test; :30-68 checks draining heartbeats, 503 rejection and reconnect busy fields without a drain barrier. AddonHoldStoreTests.swift:38-95 tests private permissions, malformed/symlink rejection and lock observation; :118-151 checks signing requirements and debug identity syntax.
Integration should verify the new local IPC/mailbox boundary against TB-003, actual audit-token authentication, release authorization, persistence/lock failure behavior and bounded resource use. Trace real cancellation and cache staging cleanup (T-010, T-028, T-041), and confirm hold/release/reconnect cannot bypass current App Attest admission or expiry (TB-011, T-052, T-053). The mock cannot establish platform routing or no-fault billing semantics (TB-002, A-009); busy/draining handling remains an external contract. No supplied tests alter encryption, keys, receipts, release qualification or fan-helper authority. Production implementations and most of AddonIPCServerTests.swift are outside this batch, so these material integration questions remain unresolved rather than findings.
